data.description: Empower customers to find the right fit during checkout whenever they add multiple sizes of the same product to their cart. Display a dynamic banner that highlights duplicate items, leads shoppers to your sizing guide, and prevents accidental multi-size orders.
data.name: Cart Consolidation Banner

template.callout: Reduce return rates and help shoppers find the right size with a real-time checkout banner.

fulfillments.description: Open the campaign and edit the banner to fit your brand and messaging. Adjust the Text and Link to Size Guide fields.
fulfillments.headline: Banner

fulfillments.description: Match the checkout event and product ID to your checkout page DataLayer structure. Copy the ID of the banner and paste it to the banner reference at the bottom of the tag.
fulfillments.headline: Tag

fulfillments.description: After launching the campaign, you can return to this evaluation dashboard to see the real-time campaign performance results. Make sure to fill in the banner_id parameter at the top of the dashboard.
fulfillments.headline: Evaluation Dashboard
